title: Sandbox payment pages place an unchecked return_url into page script (non-production)
expected: return_url is validated against the frontend origin and encoded for a JavaScript context.
actual: return_url is URL-decoded and interpolated into window.location.href='…' inside an inline script. Both routes return 404 in production (NODE_ENV check), so exposure is limited to local and any staging environment running in sandbox mode.
impact: On a staging deployment, a crafted link could run script on the API origin or redirect testers. No production impact.
fix: Accept only return URLs under getPrimaryFrontendUrl() (as subscriptionsEtb.ts already does) and pass values via JSON.stringify into the script, or drop the inline script for a plain link.
